title: Website video sizing verified with portrait preservation
summary: Product videos start with a full square stage; landscape metadata cannot shrink it, while portrait clips retain their taller natural layout.

changes.detail: Replace initial 16:9 stage with square sizing and cap loaded video aspect ratio at 1, giving landscape videos at least the photo-stage height.
Refinement to the initial report: retain dimension state and metadata callback so portrait clips preserve their existing taller stage instead of shrinking to square.
Existing gallery regression now checks initial square size, landscape size floor, portrait preservation, replay remounting and photo navigation.
